title: Repeated Measures ANOVA with Mauchly's Sphericity and Epsilon Corrections
description: Authoritative academic behavioral benchmark case for RM_ANOVA.
research_question: Does cognitive performance change significantly across four repeated time points, and does sphericity hold?

must_do.description: Test Mauchly's test of sphericity (W, chi2, df, p).
Apply Greenhouse-Geisser or Huynh-Feldt epsilon correction when sphericity is violated (p < .05).
Report pairwise time contrasts with Bonferroni alpha adjustment.

must_not_do.description: Report uncorrected sphericity-assumed F and df when Mauchly's test is violated.
Treat repeated within-subjects observations as independent between-subjects data.

required_evidence.description: Mauchly's sphericity and epsilon statistics table.
Repeated measures ANOVA table with corrected df.
